hero.title: Know exactly where you stand before the real interview.

how.title: How it works
how.step1Body: Add your resume and the job description, or choose the role you are preparing for.
how.step2Body: A structured interview that goes deeper based on your answers, just like a real interviewer.

fair.title: Assessed on what you say and build
fair.body: Your answers, reasoning and code are what count. Accent, appearance and facial expressions are never scored.

features.title: What you get

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.freeA: Yes. Every account starts with one free interview credit, so you can take a full interview before you decide to buy more.
faq.needQ: What do I need to take an interview?
faq.needA: A recent version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari. Voice interviews also need a microphone and video interviews a camera; a quick device check runs before you start.
faq.languagesA: The site and the interviews are available in English, Hindi and Telugu. You can also let the interview detect the language you speak.
faq.assessedA: On what you say and build: your answers, reasoning and code. Accent, appearance and facial expressions are never scored.
faq.privateA: Only you, unless you choose to share a proof link. If you join an interview through a company invite link, you are told before you start what that company will see.
faq.creditsA: Each interview uses 1 credit, and credits are only used when you start the interview. Purchased credits are added as soon as the payment is confirmed.

tips.situation: Start with one or two sentences of context: where you were and what was at stake.
tips.task: Say what your goal or responsibility was before describing what you did.
tips.action: Focus on what you personally did: say “I”, not only “we”.
tips.result: End with the outcome, with a number if you have one, and what you learned.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.intro: How your spoken answers came across: pace, filler words, long pauses and hedging.
delivery.fairness: Delivery is coaching only and never affects your scores. Pace and filler words vary with accent, language, nerves and speech differences, and your answers are scored on what you said, not how you said it.
delivery.noTips: Your delivery was on target. Keep practising out loud to stay consistent.

tips.PACE_FAST: Slow down a little. Pause briefly after each key point so the interviewer can follow.
tips.PACE_SLOW: Pick up the pace a little. Outline your answer in your head (situation, action, result) before you start speaking.
tips.FILLERS: Replace filler words with a short silent pause. A pause sounds more confident than “um” or “like”.
tips.PAUSES: Pausing to think is fine. Say “let me think for a moment” so the silence is clearly yours, then answer in short sentences.
tips.HEDGING: State what you did plainly (“I led”, “I decided”) instead of “I think” or “maybe”.

network.slow: Your connection is a little slow ({{ms}} ms). Answers may take longer to process.
network.verySlow: Your connection is slow ({{ms}} ms). Move closer to your Wi-Fi router or close other downloads.
network.failed: We could not measure your connection. Check that you are online.

speech.title: Speech service
speech.stt: Turning speech into text is not available right now. You may need to type your answers.
speech.tts: Questions cannot be read aloud right now. You can read them on screen.
speech.both: The speech service is not available right now. Try again later, or switch to a text interview.
speech.failed: We could not check the speech service. You can continue and switch to typing if needed.

done.title: You are ready
done.body: Your microphone and speaker are checked. Next, review the rules and start your interview.
done.videoBody: Your camera, microphone and speaker are checked. Next, review the rules and start your interview.

failed.title: Voice answers will not work on this device yet
failed.body: We could not use your microphone to record answers. Fix the problem and try again, or switch to a text interview.
failed.videoBody: We could not use your camera or microphone for a video interview. Fix the problem and try again, or switch to a text interview.

check.videoTitle: Check your camera, microphone and speaker
check.videoIntro: A quick check makes sure your camera works, the interviewer can hear you and you can hear the questions. It takes about a minute.
check.requiredFailedVideo: Your camera, microphone or browser cannot be used for a video interview right now. Fix the problem above and test again, or switch to a text interview.

camera.title: Camera
camera.intro: Press Test camera and allow the camera and microphone when your browser asks. You will see yourself here.
camera.denied: Camera access is blocked. Click the lock or camera icon in your browser's address bar, allow the camera and microphone for this site, then press Test again.
camera.noDevice: We could not find a camera. Connect a camera, then press Test again.
camera.inUse: Your camera is being used by another app. Close other apps that use it (video calls, recorders), then press Test again.
camera.unsupported: This browser cannot use a camera here. Use the latest Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
camera.other: We could not open your camera. Check that it is connected and allowed, then press Test again.
camera.noPicture: Your camera opened but we did not get a picture. Check that it is not covered or used by another app, then press Test again.

room.hint: When you are ready, press Start answering and speak. Press Done when you finish (up to {{max}}).
room.heardNothing: We did not catch any words.
room.unclear: We may not have heard you clearly. Check the text, and record again if it is wrong.
room.autoplayBlocked: Your browser did not let the question play by itself.
room.audioUnavailable: Audio is not available for this question. Read it on screen.

announce.recording: Recording started. Press Done when you finish.
announce.transcribing: Recording stopped. Turning your answer into text.
announce.review: Your answer is ready to review.

modeNow.TEXT: You are now answering by typing.
modeNow.VOICE: You are now answering by voice.
modeNow.VIDEO: You are now answering by speaking, on camera.

sttDown.title: We cannot turn speech into text right now
sttDown.body: Try again in a moment, or switch to typing your answers.

ttsDown.title: Questions can't be read aloud right now — read them on screen
ttsDown.body: You can still answer by speaking.

problems.denied: Microphone access is blocked. Allow the microphone for this site in your browser's address bar, then try again, or type your answer instead.
problems.noDevice: We could not find a microphone. Connect one and try again, or type your answer instead.
problems.inUse: Your microphone is being used by another app. Close it and try again, or type your answer instead.
problems.unsupported: This browser cannot use a microphone here. Type your answer instead.
problems.other: We could not start recording. Please try again.
problems.noFormat: This browser cannot record audio in a format we support. Type your answer instead.
problems.tooShort: That recording was too short. Press Start answering and try again.
problems.tooLarge: That recording was too long. Please give a shorter answer.
problems.format: We could not read that recording. Try again, or type your answer instead.
problems.stale: The interview had already moved on, so that recording was not used.
problems.failed: We could not process your recording. Please try again.

live.nothingYet: Start speaking. Your words appear here as you talk.
live.interruptHint: Listen to the question, or start speaking whenever you are ready. The interviewer will stop and listen.
live.keepTalking: Keep talking to add more, tap Send now to send it straight away, or Edit to correct it.
live.speakToContinue: You can also keep speaking to add to your answer.
live.unclear: We may not have heard every word clearly. Check the text, and edit it if something is wrong.
live.paused: The connection dropped. Your answer so far is kept and continues as soon as you are back online.
live.reviewPreference: Let me review my answer before it is sent

announce.grace: Your answer will be sent in {{seconds}} seconds. Keep talking to continue.

fallback.unsupported: Live transcription is not available for this interview, so answer with the record button.
fallback.unavailable: Live transcription stopped working. Record your answer with the button below instead.
fallback.slow: Your connection is too slow for live transcription. Record your answer with the button below instead.

consent.title: Your choices for this interview
consent.intro: Please read each notice and make a choice. Required notices must be accepted before the interview can start.

recording.optionalHint: Recording is optional. If you choose not to record, the video interview runs normally without a recording.

consent.requiredDeclined: This interview cannot start unless you agree to this notice.
consent.blocked: You did not agree to a required notice, so this interview cannot start. Change your choice above, or go back to setup and choose another way to take the interview.
consent.chooseAll: Make a choice for each notice to continue.
consent.nothingNeeded: This interview does not ask for any consents.

selfView.label: Your camera
selfView.unavailable: Your camera is not available. The interview continues.
selfView.lost: Your camera stopped. The interview continues.

recording.title: Interview recording

status.PARTIAL: Partial — some parts could not be saved
status.FAILED: Failed — the recording could not be saved

recording.partsNote: Your camera restarted during the interview, so the recording plays in parts. It will be joined into one video shortly.
recording.playbackFailed: The recording could not be played. Close it and try again.
recording.confirmBody: The video is deleted for good. Your report is not affected.

privacy.consentsHint: Your choices about voice processing, recording and session observations, with the notice version each one applied to.
privacy.consentsEmpty: You have not made any consent choices yet.
privacy.consentsError: We could not load your consent history.
privacy.pageIntro: Download a copy of your data, review your consent choices or delete your account. These are your rights under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
privacy.exportHint: One JSON file with your profile, sign-in methods, consents, resumes and job descriptions (with the text we read from them), interviews, transcripts, reports, purchases and credits. Recording links in the file work for a few minutes only.
privacy.deleteHint_one: Your account is locked straight away and permanently erased after {{count}} day. Signing in again before then cancels the deletion. Purchase and credit records are kept without your name or contact details, because tax law requires it.
privacy.deleteHint_other: Your account is locked straight away and permanently erased after {{count}} days. Signing in again before then cancels the deletion. Purchase and credit records are kept without your name or contact details, because tax law requires it.
privacy.deleteWarning_one: Are you sure? After {{count}} day this cannot be undone. Confirm it is you with a code, or type the word below.
privacy.deleteWarning_other: Are you sure? After {{count}} days this cannot be undone. Confirm it is you with a code, or type the word below.
privacy.deletedTitle: Your account is scheduled for deletion
privacy.deletedBody: It will be permanently erased on {{date}}. You have been signed out on every device.
privacy.deletedBodyNoDate: It will be permanently erased soon. You have been signed out on every device.
privacy.deletedCancelHint: Changed your mind? Just sign in again before then and your account will be kept.
privacy.legalHint: How we use your data, the rules of the service and how AI scores your answers.

coding.loadError: We could not load this coding problem.
coding.limits: Time limit {{cpu}} ms per test · memory {{memory}} MB
coding.hiddenNote: Hidden tests are checked when you submit; you only see whether they pass.

editor.label: Code editor ({{language}})
editor.shortcuts: Ctrl+Enter (Cmd+Enter on Mac) runs your code. Ctrl+Shift+Enter submits.

switchLanguage.title: Switch to {{language}}?
switchLanguage.body: Your current code will be replaced by the {{language}} starter code.

save.closed: Saving has stopped for this question

coding.tooLong: Your code is longer than {{max}} KB. Shorten it to save, run or submit.

submitConfirm.title: Submit your solution? You can't change it afterwards.
submitConfirm.body: Your code is checked against every test, including the hidden ones.

coding.judgeDown: Running code is temporarily unavailable — keep working; you can still submit.

problems.rateLimited: You are running code very often. Wait a moment and try again.
problems.runFailed: We could not run your code. It is still here — please try again.
problems.submitFailed: We could not submit your solution. It is still here — please try again.
problems.closed: This question is closed, so the solution could not be submitted.

results.title: Results
results.empty: Run your code to check it against the examples.

submitted.summary: Submitted. {{passed}} of {{total}} tests passed, including hidden tests.
submitted.judgeUnavailable: Submitted. The code could not be run right now; it will be reviewed from the code.
submitted.next: The interview continues with the next question.

mobile.body: Coding is easier on a laptop or desktop. You can still continue here.

campaign.intro: {{company}} has invited you to an interview for the {{role}} role.
campaign.sponsoredFree: Free for you — {{company}} covers this interview
campaign.sponsoredNote: Your credits are not used for this interview.
campaign.alreadyJoined: You have already joined this interview.
campaign.submitted: Your interview has been submitted to {{company}}. They will contact you about next steps.
campaign.loadError: We could not load this invitation

notFound.title: This invitation link is not valid
notFound.body: Check the link you were sent, or ask the company for a new one.

notices.title: Before you join
notices.ownCredits: This interview uses your own credits.
notices.sharing: Your answers and results are shared with {{company}}.
notices.reportVisible: You will also get your own readiness report.
notices.reportHidden: {{company}} keeps the report; you will not see a report for this interview.

recording.OPTIONAL: Video interviews are recorded only if you agree; it is your choice.
recording.REQUIRED: Video interviews are recorded; you will be asked to agree before you start.

notices.observations: Tab switches, focus changes and pastes are noted during the interview (observations, never judgements).

join.title: Join
join.signInFirst: Sign in or create a free account to join. You will come back here afterwards.
join.resumeHint: A resume helps tailor the questions to your experience.

closed.NOT_STARTED: This interview opens on {{date}}. Come back then to join.
closed.ENDED: This interview closed on {{date}} and is no longer accepting candidates.
closed.PAUSED: {{company}} has paused this interview for now. Please check back later.
closed.CLOSED: This interview is closed and no longer accepting candidates.
closed.FULL: This interview has reached its limit of candidates and cannot accept more.

errors.closed: This interview is not open right now. The company may have paused or closed it.

maintenance.title: Scheduled maintenance.
maintenance.fallback: We are doing maintenance. You can still sign in and view your reports, but new interviews and other changes are paused; please try again a little later.
maintenance.readOnly: You can still view your reports; changes are paused until we finish.

share.title: Share a proof
share.intro: Create a link that shows a read-only summary of this report, for example to a recruiter or on your profile.
share.shows: The proof shows your name, the role, your overall score, readiness band, evidence confidence and skill scores.
share.neverShows: It never shows your transcript, answers, evidence, recording or contact details.
share.anyone: Anyone with the link can open it until it expires or you revoke it.
share.copyNow: Copy it now: for your security it will not be shown again.
share.copyFailed: Could not copy automatically. Select the link and copy it.
share.listError: We could not load your proof links.
share.none: You have not shared a proof of this report yet.

errors.limit: You can have 5 active links for a report. Revoke one first.

view.reviewed: Reviewed by CodeBegun: this result was checked by our team.
view.scope: This proof shows scores only; the interview answers and evidence stay private.
view.notFoundTitle: This proof link is not available
view.notFoundBody: It may have expired or been revoked. Ask the candidate for a new link.
view.loadError: We could not open this proof

legal.draftBody: This text may change before it is final.
legal.officerNotConfigured: The Grievance Officer's contact details will be published here soon.

chips.hint: Type a skill and press Enter. Separate several with commas.

resume.title: What we read from your resume
resume.hint: Check this carefully. If something is wrong or missing, choose Edit: your corrections are used for the analysis, the match score and the suggestions.
resume.headline: Headline
resume.notStructured: We could not organise this resume into sections. Choose Edit to add your skills and experience yourself.

edit.invalid: Some fields are not valid. Check the dates (YYYY or YYYY-MM), the years and that every entry has a title.
edit.title: Job title

jd.title: What we read from the job description
jd.notStructured: We could not organise this job description. Choose Edit to add the skills it asks for.

match.title: Resume match
match.intro: How well your resume matches this job description, scored the way applicant tracking systems screen resumes. It is free, uses no AI, and every point is explained.
match.needBoth: Add a resume and a job description to see how well they match.
match.notReady: Your resume or job description is still being read. The score appears when both are ready.
match.noSkills: The job description does not list skills we recognise.

fit.MEETS: You have {{years}} years; the role asks for {{required}} or more.
fit.BELOW: You have {{years}} years; the role asks for {{required}} or more.
fit.ABOVE: You have {{years}} years, more than this role usually asks for.
fit.UNKNOWN: We could not compare your experience with the role.

risks.TABLES: Tables found: many screening systems read table cells out of order. Use plain lines instead.
risks.COLUMNS: Two columns found: text may be read in the wrong order. A single-column layout is safer.
risks.IMAGE_ONLY: The file is an image (scanned), so screening systems may not read any text. Upload a text-based PDF or DOCX.
risks.TOO_LONG: The resume is very long ({{words}} words). Two pages are usually enough.
risks.TOO_SHORT: The resume is very short. Add your experience, projects and skills.

reasons.NO_JD_SKILLS: The job description lists no skills we recognise, so skills are not scored.
reasons.EXPERIENCE_MEETS: Your {{years}} years meet the {{required}}+ years asked for.
reasons.EXPERIENCE_BELOW: Your {{years}} years are {{gap}} short of the {{required}}+ years asked for.
reasons.EXPERIENCE_ABOVE: Your {{years}} years are well above the {{max}} years this role asks for.
reasons.EXPERIENCE_UNKNOWN_resume: We could not work out your years of experience, so this counts half.
reasons.EXPERIENCE_UNKNOWN_jd: The job description does not say how much experience it wants, so this counts half.
reasons.LAYOUT_UNKNOWN: We could not check the formatting of this file.

tailor.title: Tailoring suggestions
tailor.honestyNote: These are suggestions only. We never change your resume, and we only reword what your resume already says. Copy only what is true for you, and fill in or delete placeholders such as [X%].
tailor.working: Preparing suggestions. This usually takes under a minute.

failed.INPUT_NOT_READY: Your resume or job description is not ready. Try again when both have been read.
failed.INTERNAL: We could not prepare suggestions. Please try again later.

tailor.fallback: Our AI service is busy, so these suggestions were put together from your resume without it: a summary made of your own facts and the keywords you are missing.

guard.METRIC_REPLACED_one: {{count}} number that is not in your resume was replaced with a placeholder.
guard.METRIC_REPLACED_other: {{count}} numbers that are not in your resume were replaced with placeholders.
guard.UNGROUNDED_BULLET_one: {{count}} suggestion that did not match your resume was removed.
guard.UNGROUNDED_BULLET_other: {{count}} suggestions that did not match your resume were removed.
guard.UNKNOWN_EMPLOYER_one: {{count}} suggestion that named an employer or tool not in your resume was removed.
guard.UNKNOWN_EMPLOYER_other: {{count}} suggestions that named employers or tools not in your resume were removed.

tailor.placeholders: Fill in {{list}} only if you know the real value, otherwise remove it.
tailor.missing: Keywords the job asks for that your resume does not show
tailor.defaultGuidance: Add this only if you have really used it. If not, it is worth learning before you apply.
tailor.noMissing: Your resume already covers the skills this job lists.
tailor.exportHint: A plain-text draft of your resume with these suggestions in place. Review every line, add your contact details and keep only what is true.
tailor.draftNotice: DRAFT: review every line before you use it. Keep only what is true and fill in or remove every placeholder.

check.title: Resume check
check.subtitle: See how well a resume matches a job description, correct what we read, and get tailoring suggestions. No interview needed.
check.needInputs: You need a resume and a job description that have been read. Add them in the new interview steps; you can stop before starting an interview.
check.addInputs: Add a resume and job description

section.needBoth: Add a resume and a job description to see your resume match score and tailoring suggestions.
section.editNote: Corrections you make here update the match score at once and are used the next time this interview is analysed.
